advisor.name: Ping Neo
advisor.bio: Provides guidance on chapter programming and connects students with research and industry opportunities across UF's Nuclear & Radiological Engineering program.

officers.name: Isabella De Paola
officers.bio: Sets the chapter's strategic direction, presides over meetings, and serves as NAYGN at UF's primary external liaison — including representing the chapter at the national NAYGN conference.

officers.name: Felipe Augusto
officers.bio: Supports the President, coordinates the officer team, oversees event logistics and accountability, and helps arrange the speaker series with local industry partners.

officers.name: Mason Fiorello
officers.bio: Manages the chapter budget, finances, and records — including fundraising, travel reimbursements for plant tours, and thorough end-of-term transition reporting.

officers.name: Leah Hopkins
officers.bio: Keeps meeting minutes, rosters, and agendas, manages chapter correspondence and the member email list, and oversees document transitions between terms.

officers.name: Kye Livezey
officers.bio: Organizes professional development opportunities including resume workshops, mock interviews, and industry plant tours, while tracking member engagement throughout the year.

officers.name: Leah Dixel
officers.bio: Runs chapter social media, publicizes events, handles outreach and media documentation, and helps make nuclear science approachable to the broader UF campus community.
